preconditions: exact current canonical source hashes match sourceBindings
QA Chrome PID and foreground HWND recorded before interaction
device is powered on and simulation/world is paused or otherwise event baseline is frozen
browser instrumentation is observation-only and does not dispatch input/focus events

browser: POWER activation event is trusted pointerdown or keydown on #key-power
exactly one trusted window blur is observed with document.hasFocus()==false
exactly one trusted window focus is observed later with document.hasFocus()==true

foreground PID/HWND during blur belongs to a different process/window
foreground PID/HWND after refocus belongs to the same QA Chrome PID again

limits: P10 did not operate desktop/window/browser and therefore does not itself verify native blur/refocus.
Synthetic dispatch tests prove adapter contracts only; they are not evidence of Windows foreground provenance.
The validator depends on truthful OS foreground PID/HWND observations captured by the UI owner; it cannot independently reconstruct missing native provenance after the fact.
D15 trusted key provenance does not imply Narrator/NVDA spoken-output verification.
No OEM physical, firmware, rights, release or accessibility-conformance claim follows from this oracle.
